question: can you top 10 expense entries of this month
sql: SELECT eh.exp_category, e.name, e.invoice_no, e.date, e.amount FROM expenses AS e JOIN expense_head AS eh ON e.exp_head_id = eh.id WHERE MONTH(e.date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(e.date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) ORDER BY e.amount DESC LIMIT 10

question: give me fees collection data
sql: SELECT s.admission_no, CONCAT_WS(' ', s.firstname, s.lastname) AS student_name, CAST(jt.amt AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS amount, jt.payment_mode, jt.payment_date FROM student_fees_deposite sfd JOIN student_fees_master sfm ON sfm.id = sfd.student_fees_master_id JOIN student_session ss ON ss.id = sfm.student_session_id JOIN students s ON s.id = ss.student_id, JSON_TABLE(sfd.amount_detail, '$.*' COLUMNS (amt VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.amount', payment_mode VARCHAR(50) PATH '$.payment_mode', payment_date DATE PATH '$.date')) AS jt ORDER BY jt.payment_date DESC LIMIT 50

question: what is the monthyl expense of our school including payroll, other item expences and all. and How much are we earning, tell me about the profits
sql: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM income WHERE MONTH(date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(date) = YEAR(CURDATE())) AS total_income, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM expenses WHERE MONTH(date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(date) = YEAR(CURDATE())) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(net_salary), 0) FROM staff_payslip WHERE MONTH(payment_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(payment_date) = YEAR(CURDATE())) AS total_expense, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM income WHERE MONTH(date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(date) = YEAR(CURDATE())) - ((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM expenses WHERE MONTH(date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(date) = YEAR(CURDATE())) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(net_salary), 0) FROM staff_payslip WHERE MONTH(payment_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(payment_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()))) AS profit
